title: GEOF Method
description: An immutable, versioned method descriptor. Any change to parameters, inputs or outputs is a new Method with supersedes set. The framework mandates no method; it mandates declaration.

class.description: sampling: frame and panel design. detection: how mention/citation/attribution is recognised. scoring: prominence, stance, impression scores. attribution: intervention-to-change and counterfactual estimation. aggregation: rates, shares, intervals. verification: fidelity, claim support, consensus. replay: reproducibility.

parameters.description: Every parameter that fixes this version (seeds, decay constants, judge model and prompt hash, rater protocol, thresholds used for detection, ...)

outputs.description: Metric definitions this method produces readings for

limitations.description: Known limitations; may be empty but must be present
